Test Case Title: Fill name, email, phone and address with valid data and check every field keeps its value.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/)
Test Steps: 1. Type the name. 2. Type the email. 3. Type the phone number. 4. Type the address. 5. Read back the four fields.
Test Data: Name "Allah Ditta", email "allah.ditta@example.com", phone "0300123456", address "Lahore, Pakistan"
Expected Result: Each field shows exactly the value that was typed (the name is cut to its 15 character limit).
